description: Preview the impact of an edit before writing to disk. Shows what errors would be introduced or resolved without touching the file. If net_delta is 0, the edit is safe to apply without further verification. Use before every apply_edit to catch problems early. All line/column positions are 1-indexed. For full function replacements, consider replace_symbol_body instead of apply_edit.

end_column.description: 1-indexed end column of the range to replace

end_line.description: 1-indexed end line of the range to replace

file_path.description: Absolute path to the file to edit within the session

language.description: Language identifier for the session (e.g. go, typescript)

new_text.description: Replacement text for the specified range

scope.description: Evaluation scope: file (fast, single file) or workspace (full, all files). Default: file

start_column.description: 1-indexed start column of the range to replace

start_line.description: 1-indexed start line of the range to replace

timeout_ms.description: Timeout in milliseconds for LSP diagnostics collection. Default: 5000

workspace_root.description: Workspace root directory for the simulation session

name: preview_edit
